children.value: > Fact From Story: Apple is in court because of something called the Information Services Agreement, or ISA: a deal that makes Google’s search engine the default on Apple’s products.

> > Fact From Story: The Justice Department is focused on the deals Google makes — with Apple but also with Samsung and Mozilla and many others — to ensure it is the default search engine on practically every platform.
> > > Fact From Story: The ISA has been in place since 2002, but Cue was responsible for negotiating its current iteration with Google CEO Sundar Pichai in 2016.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Agreements between companies can be renegotiated over time.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies enter into deals to promote their products.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A default search engine is the search engine that is automatically used when a user performs a search in a web browser or other application.
